title: Figure 47: imaginary acoustic pressure vs radial distance, 5000 Hz radiating sphere
description: ANSYS 12.1 line graph of the steady-state imaginary component of pressure (Pa) as a function of radial distance (m) for 5,000 Hz with 25 elements per wavelength in water. High-frequency decaying oscillation for the radiating sphere EPW=25. From the BAASS underwater acoustic validation plots.
